name: db_lock
verified_against: splitwise-backend 85629fc: behaviour probed locally with its own test client before these expectations were written
note: Written before any live run. Changing a file requires updating expectations.lock.json in a reviewed PR; the suite refuses to run otherwise.
scenario: A separate process repeatedly holds a SQLite write lock (BEGIN IMMEDIATE) for 8 s, longer than the app's 5 s busy timeout, while the app serves POST writes. Test rows are discarded by restoring the verified backup.
